settlement_source: Governing league (NFL, nfl.com); NFL.pdf (ACHIEVEMENTS template) also names AP, ESPN, WSJ, Fox Sports as Source Agencies
settlement_variable: First official final result of the NFC Championship game (winning team = Yes)
timezone: Expiration 10:00 AM ET (day after official result)
tie_handling: If multiple participants reported as result, Yes pays $1/N rounded down to the cent, No gets the remainder; NFL playoff ties effectively not possible (OT).
rounding: Split payouts rounded down to the nearest cent; tick $0.01
trading_close_vs_settlement: close_time 2027-02-22T15:00Z is a latest-expiry placeholder; expected to expire 10:00 AM ET the day after the official result (Rule 7.2). Settlement within a day after expiration.
early_close_or_void_clauses: can_close_early=1. Final postponed: open until result or 2 weeks after scheduled date; suspended: up to 2 years; cancelled: Yes pays last traded price (or Outcome Review Committee determination / equal split $1/N) - discretionary. Withdrawal/forfeit/disqualification/elimination => No. Post-expiry revisions ignored. Rule 6.3(d) review at sole discretion.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title says 'Pro Football NFC Championship'; PDF is a generic 'achievement' template. Team names truncated (e.g. 'New York G', 'Los Angeles R') - cosmetic.
Elimination as reported by Source Agency resolves No early, before the final game.
Cancellation pays last traded price, not 0/1.
toxicity_flags: game outcome known live; market expiry lags result
notes: Futures market until Feb 2027; before the playoffs the variable is a future event, during the game it is observable in real time.
